This is the bank to generate from: subject x format, with the words the winning titles use.
_how_to_read: format = the treatment applied to the subject. Nearly all volume on eBay UK wall art comes from a small number of formats applied across a large subject list, not from many styles of one subject.

title_grammar.wallart: {SUBJECT} {FORMAT WORDS} Art Print Wall Art {ROOM or STYLE} Poster A4 A3 Gift
title_grammar.rule: Lead with the searchable noun. Fill the remaining characters with words that differ per design, never a fixed tail repeated across the catalogue.
title_grammar.worked_example_theirs: BIKER T-SHIRT Motorbike Motorcycle Cafe Racer Chopper Bike Mens Funny Skull Top
title_grammar.worked_example_ours_before: My Nan Is A Bouncer Mens Womens T-Shirt Funny Novelty Gift Tee Top
title_grammar.worked_example_ours_after: Bouncer T-Shirt My Nan Is A Bouncer Doorman Security Gift Mens Funny Work Tee

do_not_copy.note: Both tee sellers and canvasartshop lean heavily on property. Their sold leaders are often the riskiest listings they run. We match the FORMAT, never the content.
do_not_copy.also_risky: Car manufacturer names and models. Nearly every car listing found names a marque. Generic body type plus a style is the lower-risk version and the style is what people are buying.
